deploy-bot: rollout complete for release r-2026-03-20-05 -> canaries at 10% (us-west, eu1). queued: quick synthetic sweep + health checks.

sam: saw it, starting quick-checks now. pinging /health and embed-synth harness.

ops-bot: synth-check summary (automatic): /health OK (p99 48ms), /embed-synth 2 errors / 120 runs (1.7%) — both errors in eu1 cluster. logs attached to run 1755557777.

maria: where in eu1? which worker?

jordan: looks like embed-worker-12 and embed-worker-14, timeouts on seq > 1024 requests. stacktrace shows socket read timeout.

lina: can you repro locally against eu1 staging? post the exact curl you used.

sam: here's the curl I used:```curl -s -X POST https://eu1-api.redwood/example/embed -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"text":"long prompt...","max_seq":1500}'```

ops-bot: rerun at +5m: us-west 0/60 errors, eu1 1/60 errors. p95 embed latency eu1 = 480ms (baseline 120ms).

maria: hmm. 1.7% initially then 1.6% after rerun. that's above our postdeploy threshold (0.5%). suggestion: reduce canary weight or pin eu1 to previous model variant.

jordan: my recommendation: holdcall and reduce canary weight to 1% immediately, and pin eu1 traffic to v2.0-quant while we investigate. v2.1 had a quantization kernel change that could impact long-seq paths.

sam: I can enact holdcall and cut canary to 0% if nobody objects. @maria @jordan

maria: :thumbsup: do it. also add a short note in the release changelog about the regression and pin.

deploy-bot: holdcall requested by sam. executing: canary weight -> 0% (all new traffic to stable routing), eu1 pinned to model v2.0-quant. rollback flag NOT set.

ops-bot: note for follow-up: probe coverage gap detected — current synthetic harness exercises seq lengths up to 1024 only; long-seq KV prefix/warm path not covered. plan: extend harness to include seq 2048 and KV prefix permutations.

lina: I'll open a quick PR to smoke-harness: add test matrix entry `seq-2048` + `kv-prefix-*` and tag with `postdeploy-coverage`. ETA 30m.

jordan: agree with PR. operational decision: no full rollback unless errors >1% over 30m or p95 >2x baseline on steady traffic. will monitor 30m.

ops-bot: monitoring update @10m: p95 eu1 embed now 130ms after pin; errors 0/200. leaving canaries at 0% until PR lands and we run expanded sweep.

sam: added brief note to release notes: "r-2026-03-20-05: canary paused for eu1 embed perf regression; eu1 pinned to v2.0-quant; synthetic coverage to be expanded to long sequences."

maria: thanks. closing this thread after 30m stable check. :white_check_mark:

(automated) ops-bot: follow-up checklist created: tickets #INF-4212 (expand synth), #INF-4213 (investigate embed-worker timeouts), #INF-4214 (update release changelog).
